description: This PHP source file contains helper functions for the ADOdb database abstraction layer, including functions for manipulating SQL queries, handling database recordsets, and debugging. It is designed to provide auxiliary utilities to reduce the size of the main adodb.inc.php file and facilitate database operations in PHP projects.

methods.name: adodb_strip_order_by
methods.description: Removes the ORDER BY clause from an SQL SELECT statement's outer query to facilitate SQL rewriting.

methods.name: adodb_probetypes
methods.description: Guesses data types of array elements by inspecting string patterns, used for determining column types.

methods.name: adodb_transpose
methods.description: Transposes a 2D array, optionally creating a header row, used for data reshaping.

methods.name: _adodb_replace
methods.description: Performs an UPSERT operation (update or insert) on a table based on key fields.

methods.name: _adodb_getmenu
methods.description: Generates HTML select options from a recordset, with support for default and blank options.

methods.name: _adodb_getmenu_gp
methods.description: Generates HTML select options with grouping support from a recordset.

methods.name: _adodb_getmenu_select
methods.description: Starts an HTML SELECT tag for dropdowns, supporting multiple selection and size.

methods.name: _adodb_getmenu_option
methods.description: Generates an HTML option element, marking it selected if it matches the default.

methods.name: _adodb_getcount
methods.description: Computes record count for an SQL query by rewriting it into a COUNT(*) query.

methods.name: _adodb_pageexecute_all_rows
methods.description: Executes a paginated query retrieving all rows and providing record count and pagination info.

methods.name: _adodb_pageexecute_no_last_page
methods.description: Executes a paginated query without fetching total record count, indicating last page differently.

methods.name: _adodb_quote_fieldname
methods.description: Properly case-converts and quotes a database field name based on configuration.

methods.name: _adodb_getupdatesql
methods.description: Constructs SQL UPDATE statements based on modified recordset fields.

methods.name: _adodb_key_exists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in an array, with optional handling of null or empty values.

methods.name: _adodb_getinsertsql
methods.description: Constructs SQL INSERT statements from a recordset and an array of fields.

methods.name: _adodb_column_sql_oci8
methods.description: Handles BLOB and other special data types for Oracle OCI8 driver in SQL statements.

methods.name: _adodb_column_sql
methods.description: Generates driver-specific SQL for column values, supporting different data types.

methods.name: _adodb_debug_execute
methods.description: Wraps query execution with debug output, including formatted SQL and parameters.

methods.name: _adodb_backtrace
methods.description: Outputs a formatted debug backtrace for troubleshooting.
